lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered horizontal rows of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters distributed across the visible posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, forming a discernible grid-like pattern on the posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features on the upper visible flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance upper boundaries and shadowed lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the upper caudal fin lobe; faint light-colored irregular patches are present on the caudal peduncle.
